title: quetzalia standleyi
intro: Quetzalia standleyi, commonly known as the Standley's Quetzalia, is a plant species native to Mexico, belonging to the family Celastraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Quetzalia standleyi are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which make it an effective remedy for relieving pain and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Quetzalia standleyi include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
